notes:
- A pack (one folder with a folder for each model inside, like a Patreon starter library) now shows every model as its own card. Before, the whole pack was one card and the models in it were easy to miss.
- New packs are split by themselves. For a folder you already had, open it or right-click it: if it looks like a pack the app offers to show its models separately.
- Each model from a pack says which pack it came from, and one click shows the rest of that pack.
- Changed your mind? Right-click one of them and choose Show Its Pack as One Card. Nothing is moved or renamed on your disk either way.
- A model whose parts are in folders (Head, Body, Supported, STL and so on) stays as one card.
